promptSet.description:
Private Second Brain AI System – Build a Fully Private Second Brain with Local Embeddings & Obsidian

Keep your personal journal, project notes, and company secrets 100% private. Learn how to connect Obsidian with Ollama and local vector embeddings so you can chat with your second brain completely offline.

Built for knowledge workers, tech operators, and fast-paced teams, Private Second Brain AI System removes administrative bottlenecks, automates high-frequency routines, and maximizes daily output.

Key Features:
• Install Obsidian and the Smart Connections community plugin.
• Run Ollama with a local embedding model (nomic-embed-text).
• Query your personal notes with instant semantic retrieval and zero cloud upload.
• Semantic synthesis of your personal notes with direct links to individual markdown files.

Official Website: https://obsidian.md/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DXOlWi-juLn/
